about: The write rule Pi's enforcer extension and Vibe's pre_tool hook hold a file tool to, as shared vectors (harnesses/pi/tests/test_enforcer_ext.py, harnesses/vibe/tests/test_vibe_hook.py). {tmp} is a fresh directory holding work/ (the one write root, cwd), work/real/ and home/; `symlinks` are created first. `checked` is the path the call is rewritten to, null when refused.

cases.why: a symlink out of the roots is followed, as the write would
`..` after a symlink: its target's parent
a dangling symlink: the write creates its target
a root's name as a prefix
a space a tool might normalize after the check
